_comment: byte-identity CONTROL for _ft63_prires_smoke.json.  Extends the same base with
the census OFF and nothing else changed, so gate 1 (spec section 9.1) is
runnable at SMOKE scale, which is where a byte-identity break should be caught
EXPECTED DIFFS, and no others: network_prior_residual.csv exists only in the ON
arm; network_events.csv gains PRIORRES rows; network_epoch_status.csv gains the
five prires_* COLUMNS (they are appended to the schema only when armed, so the
OFF file is byte-identical to a pre-card build's); the run manifest and every
wall-clock field differ.  Everything else -- products, network_trace.csv,
network_solution.csv, the RAIM/clock/DD artifacts -- must be byte-identical.
A diff anywhere else is a STOP: the card claims the solve is untouched, and
that claim IS the acceptance criterion (standing invariant #6).
Run both arms from the SAME BUILD (verification integers are build-config
sensitive at the ppm level) and from DISTINCT working directories, since
logs/ is the fixed output root.
